description: This source file defines the IntegrationModule class, which is a JPA entity representing a module configuration within the system. It includes fields for module attributes, configuration details, audit information, and references to external models. The class is part of the core business system model related to module configurations.

classes.name: IntegrationModule
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing a module configuration, including attributes like module name, code, configuration data, images, and audit info, with transient fields for runtime module configurations and regions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the module configuration.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the module configuration.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the module name.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the regions string.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the regions string.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the configuration data stored as a string.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration data.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the module.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the module.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image URL or identifier.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or identifier.

methods.name: isCustomModule
methods.description: Checks if the module is a custom module.

methods.name: setCustomModule
methods.description: Marks the module as custom or not.

methods.name: getConfigDetails
methods.description: Returns detailed configuration information.

methods.name: setConfigDetails
methods.description: Sets detailed configuration information.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the module.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the module.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section containing audit info.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for audit info.

methods.name: getRegionsSet
methods.description: Returns the set of regions.

methods.name: setRegionsSet
methods.description: Sets the regions set.

methods.name: getModuleConfigs
methods.description: Returns the map of module configurations by environment.

methods.name: setModuleConfigs
methods.description: Sets the map of module configurations.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns additional details as a map.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets additional details.
